scripts.dev:sandbox: npx wrangler pages dev dist --d1 DB=smart-link-f-db --local --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name wow-smart-manager
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name wow-smart-manager
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply smart-link-f-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:prod: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply smart-link-f-db --remote
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed
